anchor: Plan v12 Q7 — commercial office rent cross-validation against Cushman & Wakefield / JLL 2024 MarketBeat reports. Sources cited per entry; canonical values converted USD/sqft/year → USD/sqm/year by ×10.764.
method: Single-city WebSearch against cushmanwakefield.com / JLL marketbeat reports for each city's 2024 prime office asking rent. SMB-realistic median targeted; results capture borough-wide or Class A median per Atlas convention.

US-CITY-new-york.notes: Our borough-wide value sits between Cushman Class B ($61.86) and Class A ($77.52). Tracks the Manhattan-aggregate average within 10%.

US-CITY-new-york-midtown.notes: Our Midtown override $1100 exceeds Class A Manhattan average by 32%. Plausible only if 'Midtown' is interpreted as Park Avenue / Plaza District premium corridor ($100-150/sqft) rather than blended Midtown Class A. Recommend founder review — either rename to 'Plaza District' or reduce to ~$880.

GB-CITY-london.notes: Within 5% of Cushman City Core prime. Excellent match for SMB-targeted average.

JP-CITY-tokyo.canonical_basis: Tokyo Marunouchi Grade A JPY 34,610/tsubo/month 2024 Q3 (tsubo = 3.306 sqm; JPY 150/USD)
JP-CITY-tokyo.notes: Our value sits between Tokyo Grade A average ($837) and Marunouchi premium (¥45,000/tsubo = $1,089). SMB-realistic median for Tokyo CBD.

HK-CITY-hong-kong.canonical_basis: Hong Kong Central Grade A HK$90/sqft/month avg early 2026 × 12 × 10.764 / 7.84 HKD/USD
HK-CITY-hong-kong.notes: Within 2% of Central Grade A average. Premium Grade AAA reaches $2,191/sqm/yr — our value captures the SMB Grade A median.

SG-CITY-singapore.canonical_basis: Singapore CBD Grade A SGD 11.53/sqft/month 2024 Q4 × 12 × 10.764 / 1.35 SGD/USD
SG-CITY-singapore.notes: Within 10% of Colliers Q4 2024 CBD Grade A. Higher quarters touched SGD 11.95.

FR-CITY-paris.notes: Our value undershoots Paris-Central prime by 22% but is realistic for a blended Paris SMB median (mix of arrondissements 1-9 CBD + 10-20 fringe). La Défense average $594/sqm is much lower; our $940 is the right blended median.

review_queue.issue: Midtown override $1100/sqm/yr too high vs Class A Manhattan average $834. Decision needed: clarify as 'Plaza District' or reduce.
